answer: Reaching the beacon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The vine holds work receipts rather than names, so the hollow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
